purpose: Correct terminal-noise mismatch before adding overlap confidence
architecture: Existing per-view pools -> pretrained Encoder12 without Z -> query and support tokens through pretrained Decoder12 -> denoiser4 -> CAR

model.timestep_sampling: uniform integer in [0, 99]; one timestep per training episode
model.prediction_target: x0, clean direction and moment channels

training.initialization_policy: Explicit strict-compatible weight transfer, not optimizer resume; schedule is intentionally replaced
training.loss: Unchanged x0 MSE + 0.5*(direction smooth L1 + 0.5*moment smooth L1) + original Global-masked CAR pose loss

validation.seen_sampling: Fixed seed; proportional stage then dataset/scene sampling, original indices recorded
validation.sampling_start: Independent standard Gaussian rays; no query GT used as inference input
validation.comparison_policy: Compare old models on the same seen5000; do not compare new subset aggregates directly with old full-seen aggregates

paper_differences: Only the diffusion noise schedule and deterministic DDPM principle follow RayDiffusion. Keep NeuLoc conditioning, pooling, losses and CAR. Full 100-step sampling returns final predicted x0; no paper-specific early-stop tuning. This is not a full paper reproduction.
